name: PageSection
description: A basic full-width section to separate content areas, with optional background color or gradient. Intended for automatic use as the wrapper for Container components and as the parent for components that are not intended to be nested, such as those extending WrappedLayoutComponent.

colorTheme.description: Colour keyword for theming purposes. May be used for headings, buttons, accents, and other UI elements according to the component implementation.

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: Inner components to be rendered within this component
